name: @agentskiss/install
description: One-line install, service setup and guided onboarding for agentsKISS (launchd/systemd/WSL)

scripts.build: sh -c 'if command -v shellcheck >/dev/null 2>&1; then shellcheck bootstrap.sh onboard.sh uninstall.sh bin/agentskiss bin/agentskiss-daemon lib/*.sh test/cli-forwarding.sh; else echo "shellcheck not installed; skipping shell lint"; fi && sh test/cli-forwarding.sh'
